name: ops
description: Everyday host checks: disk, memory, GPUs, containers and their logs. Read-only.

commands.name: disk_usage
commands.description: Free and used space for a filesystem path (df -h).

commands.name: memory
commands.description: RAM and swap in MiB, plus load average and uptime.

commands.name: gpu_status
commands.description: Per-GPU memory, utilisation, temperature and power, and which processes hold GPU memory.

commands.name: containers
commands.description: All containers with image and status (running and stopped).

commands.name: container_logs
commands.description: The last N log lines of one container, stdout and stderr together.

lines.description: how many lines from the end
